issues.detail: The Greek 'καινη η κοινωνια' (the new fellowship/communion) is rendered as 'sự thông công' (fellowship), omitting the adjective 'καινη' (new).
The Greek 'απο των αιωνων' (from the ages/eternal) is rendered as 'từ các đời' (from the generations/eras), which slightly shifts the theological scope from 'eternal' to 'historical periods'.
